name: Northeast Palace Bar & Grill
description: Northeast Palace is a lively karaoke venue known for its welcoming atmosphere and diverse crowd. It offers a vibrant environment with strong drinks, good food, and regular karaoke nights, especially on Mondays and weekends. The venue features a cozy, dive bar vibe with outdoor patios, live music, and themed nights, making it a favorite spot for locals and visitors seeking fun, music, and community in a relaxed setting.
